body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> 'Hybrid ODD', selected as the Visionary Awards Finalist of 'Storage Visions 2011'
Proved the matchless optical drive & storage technology of Hitachi-LG Data Storage

Hitachi-LG Data Storage(as below HLDS), the top 1 enterprise at Optical Storage Drive global market, announced that its 'Hybrid ODD' is selected as the Visionary Awards Finalist of 'Storage Visions 2011' held at the Riviera Hotel Convention Center in Las Vegas, Nevada, January 4-5, 2011.
(Picture: The Laptop with 'Hybrid ODD' that HLDS had unveiled at CEATEC 2010)

The 2011 Storage Visions Conference is about media and entertainment technology related storage, consumer electronics, computer application program and digital storage and also an international partner of the CES 2011, the world's largest consumer electronics show.
The details of the announcement of HLDS at this conference can be found on http://www.storagevisions.com/2011/Book/Luke%20Choi.pdf

The Visionary Award Finalist 'Hybrid ODD' is excellent product for multi-tasking and multimedia playing by shortening booting time with the next generation storage drive SSD(Solid state drive) at the existing Blu-ray optical drive.

HLDS had introduced the 2nd generation Hybrid ODD as the follow-up product of 1st generation hybrid drive with SSD at the world's first at 'CEATEC 2010', the Japanese largest IT exhibition in last October.

The 2nd generation Hybrid ODD has the improved speed based on SATA III(6.0Gbps) compared to the existing 1st generation product. It also realizes perfectly the existing ODD structure with the way of adjusting one SATA port by integrating ODD(Optical Disc Drive) and SSD circuit at one integrated PCB.

HLDS has a strategy entering the 2nd generation product into the market in 2011 along with this selection as the Visionary Award Finalist. For this, it's maintaining strong partnership with PC platforms such as AMD and Micron, NAND manufacturers and PC Manufacturers.

Business world is regarding SSD as not a simple storage device but a driving gear of operating system and main application for shortening of booting time and improving of performance through Hybrid ODD. This improved 2nd generation product is expected to play a role for SSD dissemination in 2011 PC market.

Hitachi-LG Data Storage, Inc.(HLDS), a joint venture of Hitachi Ltd. and LG Electronics Inc., has been maintaining Global No.1 position in the world optical storage market since its establishment in 2001.

Based on the source technology from Hitachi Ltd. and the application technology from LG Electronics, Inc., creating technical synergy effect between each other, HLDS has been able to become world's leading company in the optical storage industry.
Also, due to its powerful market leadership, HLDS was able to maintain a No.1 global market share for 9 consecutive years since its establishment.

HLDS is still in its challenge to become the new "Total Storage Solution Provider" in the market by extending its business area to new storage devices such as NAS (Network Attached Storage) while also strengthening the existing optical storage leadership through cutting edge technology, strong marketing power and enhanced service structure for DVD-Rewriter, Blu-Ray/DVD-W Combination Drive, Blu-Ray Rewriter etc.
